profile_text: With a strong focus on administrative and support services, this Düsseldorf-based firm has achieved remarkable growth of 131.7% since its baseline, driven by its expertise in providing continuity solutions. As a GmbH with a capital of €130,000, it has established itself as a key player in the sector, leveraging its team of 95 employees to deliver high-quality services. Its rapid expansion has earned it a "Scaler" category designation, reflecting its significant increase in size and influence.
